## Environment
NAS / Linux version, Docker version, router model / firmware, IPv4/IPv6 setup.

## Expected and actual behavior
Include steps to reproduce and whether the client gateway is the core IP.

## Recovery / diagnostics
What did you try? Use fictional IPs and MACs. Never upload runtime, passwords, subscription URLs or unredacted logs.
